data.text: Why does the login page keep sending me back after I sign in?
The session cookie uses SameSite=Strict, so the browser drops it on the redirect back from sign-in.

Switching to Lax fixes the loop. All 12 tests pass.

```mermaid
---
title: Sign-in flow
---
flowchart LR
  A[Sign in] --> B[Check session cookie] --> C[Home]
```

| Property | Current | Fixed |
|---|---|---|
| SameSite | Strict | Lax |
| Lifetime | 24 h | 24 h |
